تحتجمن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَجِمْنَ (taḥtajimna) /taħ.ta.d͡ʒim.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# تُحْتَجَمْنَ (tuḥtajamna) /tuħ.ta.d͡ʒam.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
